name: Integer Precision Loss
threat_model: An early depositor exploits integer truncation and donation-sensitive share pricing so a later depositor receives fewer shares than their contribution warrants.
assumptions: The pool uses integer arithmetic and the example token units.
The tested attack depends on low initial share supply and a donation that changes the live asset balance.
The remediated example's virtual liquidity softens the demonstrated case but does not prevent every inflation attack.
invariant: Share claims remain proportional to contributed assets within the rounding policy, and a deposit cannot silently mint zero shares.

detector_expectations.expectation: numeric intent and donation-sensitive share economics are not established by static analysis
